notes.title: Small patch for Endless Mode
notes.notes:
Hello, here are the changes:

 Death Screen: The death screen now displays how many minutes the run has lasted.
 Endless Mode: Death screen in Endless Mode now additionally displays how many hitmen you've managed to kill.
 Endless Mode: Hitmen's time per info still decreases by -5s for every hitmen killed, but it's capped at 15s per info and won't go lower than that.
 Endless Mode: Fixed a bug which caused hitmen to be spawn in a massive wave.

notes.title: Small update, adding AZERTY keyboards and more.
notes.notes:
Here's the change list:

 AZERTY Keyboards: Added support for french AZERTY keyboards in the settings menu.
 Checker App: Checker app now keeps keyboard focus after typing something in the text field.
 Flashlight: After feedback by a lot of people on Discord, the flashlight doesn't blink anymore.

notes.title: Quick bugfix
notes.notes:
Here's the changes list:

 Browser: Fixed bug which allowed you to quit browser during loading and avoid the anxiety hit while still discovering the link.
 Window: Newly created windows now appear on top of older windows.

notes.title: Small patch fixing letter minigame bug
notes.notes:
Here's the changes list:

 Letter Minigame: The timer to complete a letter game scales with the number of letters. For example, medium hacks give you 0.55s per letter, hard hacks 0.5s per letter, and hard hacks with disappearing letters 0.6s per letter. There was a bug which caused the minigame to give the player from 0.3s to 1.0s per letter, randomly chosen. This has been now fixed.
 Letter Minigame: The medium letter minigame spawned from 8 to 14 letters. In this patch, I've averaged it to 10 to 12 letters so it's less random.

notes.title: Another small patch
notes.notes:
Here's the changes list:

 DeployAI: if you don't recognize the name, it's an app that lets you win the game after completing all three NSA sites. There were some minor improvements to it in this patch: there is now a "New App Installed" notification when MARKOV gives it to you and there were some improvements with the sound in the final cutscene.
 ETH: the ETH value you have is displayed with 5 fractional digits, but apparently it's not enough to prevent some rare artifacts to appear. The sixth digit of the ETH value now rounds to 0 to make sure the value is displayed properly.

notes.title: Another small update for today
notes.notes:
Small patchnotes list:

 Game Wiki: added a "4+ Hitmans" section in the game wiki, explaining how only first three hitmans have fixed time to kill the player, and the fourth hitman + every next one are generated more randomly and the time until they kill you depends on how complex they generate.
 Blogs: when visiting the first hackable blog, the player now receives a one time hint saying "I bet there is something hidden in here". This is to help players realize you can hover over a sentence there and get EXP + ETH for hacking the blog.
 Desktop Help Notes: deleted the "blogs" help note because it is no longer necessary (look change above). The help notes now form a nice square.

notes.title: Another minor patch
notes.notes:
Another minor patch for today:

 Minigames: The line minigame on the hard difficulty is now 8% wider and 5% slower.
 Checker: When visiting the Checker.onion website for the first time, it now displays a hint that buying this app will allow you to earn money.
 Game Wiki: minor improvements to the game wiki.
 Hitman Usernames: some usernames had confusing nicknames, due to the fact that "l" and "I" look the same in the Chatter app font. It was hard to type their name correctly in the Scanner app. This has been now (mainly) fixed.
